greetings.self: Dear one, this message is for you alone.
greetings.career: Dear one, about the work of your hands and your days:
greetings.relationship: Dear one, about the bonds that hold your heart:
greetings.family: Dear one, about the people you call home:

situation: Right now your story is coloured by {a} and {b}.
obstacle: {card} sits across your path, asking you to look honestly at {word}.

major.upright: The guidance comes from the great arcana, so trust it: step forward into what is already calling you.
major.reversed: The guidance comes from the great arcana, but it comes softly: before you act, let something old settle inside you.

wands.upright: Follow the spark. Start before you feel ready, and let your enthusiasm open the door.
wands.reversed: Your fire is real, but scattered. Choose one flame and tend it instead of chasing every spark.

cups.upright: Lead with your heart. Say the tender thing, and let yourself be met.
cups.reversed: Your heart needs your own care first. Fill your cup quietly before you pour for anyone else.

swords.upright: Speak plainly and decide. Clarity is a kindness, to you and to everyone around you.
swords.reversed: Your thoughts are louder than the truth. Rest your mind, and the answer will cut through on its own.

pentacles.upright: Take one steady, practical step. Small and real beats grand and imagined.
pentacles.reversed: Slow down and check the ground beneath you. Security grows from patience, not from pushing.

omens.major_chapter: Three great arcana gathered for you: this is a chapter of your life, not a passing moment.
omens.reversed_blocks: Several cards turned away from you, so be gentle: what's blocked outside is often waiting inside.

suits.wands: Fire runs through this spread, so your energy is your greatest ally.
suits.cups: Water runs through this spread, so your feelings are the compass.
suits.swords: Air runs through this spread, so the right words will change everything.
suits.pentacles: Earth runs through this spread, so build slowly and it will last.

closings.self: Be as patient with yourself as you would be with someone you love.
closings.career: Your work is worth doing well, and you are worth more than your work.
closings.relationship: Love grows where it is tended. Tend it, and let it tend you.
closings.family: Roots hold even when branches sway. You belong.
